title: Fourier support of an affine subspace indicator
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $a,\gamma$ be vectors in that space. The vector Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the indicator of the affine subspace $a+H$ is nonzero if and only if $\gamma$ is orthogonal to every vector in $H$ under the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
